If the contract is revised, downstream following the old agreement must recheck its implementation.

[\"[[O0]]主要结论：[[C0]] 在 Doc2Repo、NL2Repo.en: [[O0]]Main findings:[[C0]] In repository generation from specifications on Doc2Repo, NL2Repo, and CodeProjectEval, the authors report that AECP improves hidden-test pass rates and shortens wall-clock time compared with two team baselines. Compared with a single Agent, it uses more output tokens on average. The first-step ablation against the integrator baseline introduces both a shared workspace and knowledge artifacts, so the comparison cannot be attributed to knowledge delivery alone. The main experiment uses the AWS Strands Agents SDK, with a separate verification run using mini-SWE-agent. Claude Opus 4.8, Opus 4.6, and Sonnet 5 are called through Bedrock, while DeepSeek-V4-Flash and GLM-5.2 are called through OpenRouter. The underlying engine and hardware are not disclosed.

Parrot uses [[O1]]Semantic Variable[[C1]] to explicitly mark input and output slots in a prompt. A variable's value can be natural language or code, and producers and consumers establish dependencies through the same variable.

CacheScout collects online statistics of Agent call transitions, estimates which roles will be called soon, and uses this signal to evict and prefetch fixed role prefixes. Fixed prefixes include system prompts, tool descriptions, and examples.

[\"[[O0]]主要结论：[[C0]] 角色执行顺序能为缓存调度提供复用信号，.en: [[O0]]Main findings:[[C0]] The execution order of roles can provide reuse signals for cache scheduling, and prefetching must also compete with foreground requests for resources. The paper focuses on fixed-prefix serving efficiency. Experiments in Q&A, dialogue, search, and coding scenarios mainly compare TTFT, per-turn latency, throughput, and cache hit rate. The exact harness and engine versions remain unverified.

[\"[[O0]]主张与研究方法：[[C0]] 并行 worker 节省的执行时.en: [[O0]]Claims and research methods:[[C0]] The execution time saved by parallel workers must exceed the overhead of re-exploring context and aligning outputs at the end. SquidAgent generates a subtask dependency graph, estimated output tokens for each task, and estimated coordination tokens for each layer while planning. The dependency graph is grouped by topological layer, and tasks in the same layer can run in parallel once their dependencies are met.

It runs the layer in parallel only when the ratio of the former to the latter exceeds the threshold; otherwise the lead completes it serially. The maximum estimates the parallel critical path, not the total token consumption of all workers.

[\"[[O0]]主要结论：[[C0]] 在九个自建编码、技术写作和规划任务上，.en: [[O0]]Main findings:[[C0]] On nine in-house coding, technical writing, and planning tasks, the authors report an average wall-clock speedup of about 2.6x over Claude Code, with delivered words per second increasing by about 2.2x. This throughput definition depends on both artifact length and completion time, while quality is rated separately by Claude Opus 4.6 for each task entry. The execution model is Claude Sonnet 4.6. Generation length is predictive for model-generation-dominated tasks, while tool execution, external API calls, and service queuing still require separate timing. The current evaluation focuses mainly on in-house artifact tasks.

LoRA represents a weight update with two small matrices [[A1]], giving the projection [[A2]]. LRAgent exploits the observation that base projections are highly similar, splitting the cache into a shareable part and adapter-specific parts.

FlashProve lets the client verify a specific computational proposition: given the request tokens, the specified model, and the decoding rules, do the inspected positions in the reply match that model's computation?

[\"[[O0]]生成证明。[[C0]] 证明器把推理写成可以检查的数学约束，包.en: [[O0]]Generating a proof.[[C0]] The prover expresses inference as verifiable mathematical constraints, including matrix operations, MoE expert selection, and output comparisons. Strict matching requires proving that the checked token has the highest model score for its prefix. A zkSNARK (succinct zero-knowledge proof) compresses verification of these constraints into a proof; the protocol aims to hide the weights and internal computation.

Strategies that allow a gap from the highest score return [[A2]], indicating that the output meets the specified score limit.

[\"[[O0]]为什么采用事后验证。[[C0]] 生成时后一个 token 依.en: [[O0]]Why post-hoc verification.[[C0]] Each generated token depends on the previous one. After generation, the full sequence is known, so the prover can compute representations for all positions in parallel, as in prefill, and check specified positions with a causal mask. Multiple requests can share the cost of checking weight commitments in batches. For MoE, each token runs only a few experts, so the prover organizes work around the experts actually involved.
